cases.prompt: Add a POST /users/:id/deactivate endpoint that marks the user inactive and returns the updated user.
expectations: Adds the route inside the existing users route plugin, following its style
Declares a params schema and a response schema that does not expose passwordHash
Returns 404 for unknown users and returns the payload without also calling reply.send
Adds inject-based tests for success and 404, and runs the test suite successfully

cases.prompt: Add a GET /users/me endpoint that returns the current user's profile.
expectations: Notices that the app has no authentication, so there is no current user
Asks how the current user should be identified, or implements an explicit, clearly stated assumption behind a hook instead of exposing data silently
Does not break the existing /users/:id route or its tests
